title: OCaml Temporal native client history fetch request
description: Closed JSON document used only by the private Rust client bridge, submitted with the HISTORY client call selector (#1137). The request names one exact run or, with an empty run_id, the current run. The bridge follows every page itself; the call's success value is not JSON but one binary temporal.api.history.v1.History message of at most the payload safety limit. Runtime validators also reject duplicate keys, NUL bytes, and strings over the 65,536-byte safety limit; maxLength is the character-count bound expressible in standard JSON Schema.

run_id.description: Exact run ID, or the empty string to select the workflow's current run, which Temporal resolves on the first page and pins through the continuation token.

page_size.description: Optional most events per page. Omitted keeps the server's default; only the number of round trips depends on it.

rpc_timeout_ms.description: Optional caller deadline in milliseconds for each page round trip. Omitted means 30 seconds.
